title: Colosseum 1.3.0
summary: Nuvio joins Theatre, with new Tributes, opt-in Live Reading, and fixes across Theatre and Universes.

highlights.title: More Theatre sources
highlights.body: Connect Nuvio for optional Theatre sync. Opt in to native plugin repositories and sources on Windows and Linux.

highlights.title: Marvel and Dexter
highlights.body: Explore the Marvel Infinity Gauntlet and Dexter Tribute experiences.

highlights.title: Read as pages arrive
highlights.body: Enable Live Reading in Tankoban Chapter Mode to open available pages while a manga chapter downloads.

highlights.title: Seasons stay reachable
highlights.body: Use the repaired season bar and episode scrolling, with clearer account import choices.

highlights.title: Find comic releases
highlights.body: Universe comic pages list their releases. The catalogue opens over the shell wallpaper.

highlights.title: Requests inside Colosseum
highlights.body: Use the in-app report, feature request, and Universe request forms. Browse compact Extensions shelves and shared icon tooltips.
